plainLanguage.whatItIs: A free local resume builder: one career history, many tailored resume versions (builds), ATS-friendly PDF export.
plainLanguage.whoFor: Anyone preparing job applications who wants clear structure without retyping their history each time — and without putting resume PII in a cloud account.
plainLanguage.howToStart: Open the app → How to use tutorial, or follow Layout → Contact → Summary → Skills → Experience → This build → PDF.
plainLanguage.dataNote: Contact info and resume content stay on this device only. No account, no cloud sync of resume fields. Export JSON/PDF only when the user chooses.
